text: You're looking for a delicious and dairy-free meal that fits within your 45-minute time frame, and this Spicy Dill Rice recipe checks all those boxes. The dish is made with basmati rice, which is a great source of complex carbohydrates, and is paired with chicken stock for added protein. The addition of chopped onion, jalapeno, and fresh dill gives the dish a flavorful and aromatic twist, while keeping the sugar content relatively low at just 3g per serving. This recipe should satisfy your cravings for rice and chicken while meeting your dietary requirements.
